1.1: Kol kinnuye nedarim kindarim, vacharamim kacharamim, ushevuot kishvuot, unezirut kinzirut. haomer lachavero, muddarni mimmecha, mufrashni mimmecha, meruchakni mimmecha, sheeni ochel lach, sheeni toem lach, asur. menudde ani lach, rabbi akiva haya chochech baze lehachamir. kenidre reshaim, nadar benazir, uvekarban, uvishvua. kenidre chesherim, lo amar kelum. kenidvotam, nadar benazir uvekarban:
1.2: Haomer lachavero, konam konach, konas, hare ellu chinnuyin lekarban. cherek cherech, cheref, hare ellu chinnuyin lecherem. nazik naziach, paziach, hare ellu chinnuyin linzirut. shevuta, shekuka, nadar bemota, hare ellu chinnuyin lishvua:
1.3: Haomer lo chullin lo ochal lach, lo chasher, velo deche, tahor, vetame, notar, ufiggul, asur. keimmera, kaddirin, kaetzim, kaishshim, kammizbeach, kahechol, kirushalayim, nadar beechad mikkol meshammeshe hammizbeach, af al pi shello hizkir karban, hare ze nadar bekarban. rabbi yehuda omer, haomer yerushalayim, lo amar kelum:
1.4: Haomer, karban, ola, mincha, chattat, toda, shelamim sheeni ochel lach, asur. rabbi yehuda mattir. hakkarban, kekarban, karban sheochal lach, asur. lekarban lo ochal lach, rabbi meir oser. haomer lachavero, konam pi hamedabber immach, yadi osa immach, ragli mehallechet immach, asur:

2.1: Veellu muttarin. chullin sheochal lach, kivsar chazir, kaavoda zara, keorot levuvin, kinvelot, kitrefot, kishkatzim, kirmasim, kechallat aharon vechitrumato, muttar. haomer leishto, hare at alay keimma, potchin lo fetach mimmakom acher, shello yakel rosho lechach. konam sheeni yashen, sheeni medabber, sheeni mehallech, haomer leishto, konam sheeni meshammeshech, hare ze velo yachel devaro. shevua sheeni yashen, sheeni medabber, sheeni mehallech, asur:
2.2: Karban lo ochal lach, karban sheochal lach, lo karban lo ochal lach, muttar. shevua lo ochal lach, shevua sheochal lach, lo shevua lo ochal lach, asur. ze chomer bashshevuot mibbannedarim. vechomer bannedarim mibbashshevuot, ketzad, amar, konam sukka sheani ose, lulav sheani notel, tefillin sheani meniach, bannedarim asur, bashshevuot muttar, sheen nishbain laavor al hammitzvot:
2.3: Yesh neder betoch neder, veen shevua betoch shevua. ketzad, amar hareni nazir im ochal, hareni nazir im ochal, veachal, chayyav al kol achat veechat. shevua shello ochal, shevua shello ochal, veachal, eno chayyav ella echat:
2.4: Setam nedarim lehachemir, uferusham lehakel. ketzad, amar hare alay kevasar maliach, keyen nesech, im shel shamayim nadar, asur. im shel avoda zara nadar, muttar. veim setam, asur. hare alay kecherem, im kecherem shel shamayim, asur. veim kecherem shel kohanim, muttar. veim setam, asur. hare alay kemaaser, im kemasar behema nadar, asur. veim shel goren, muttar. veim setam, asur. hare alay kitruma, im kitrumat hallishka nadar, asur. veim shel goren, muttar. veim setam, asur, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, setam teruma bihuda asura, baggalil mutteret, sheen anshe galil makkirin et terumat hallishka. setam charamim, bihuda muttarin, uvaggalil asurin, sheen anshe galil makkirin et cherme hakkohanim:
2.5: Nadar becherem veamar, lo nadarti ella vechermo shel yam. bekarban, veamar, lo nadarti ella vekarbanot shel melachim. hare atzmi karban, veamar, lo nadarti ella veetzem shehinnachti li lihyot noder bo. konam ishti nehenet li, veamar lo nadarti ella veishti harishona sheggerashti, al kullan en nishalim lahem. veim nishalu, onshin otan umachmirin alehen, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, potchin lahem petach mimmakom acher, umelammedim otan kede shello yinhagu kallut rosh bannedarim:

3.1: Arbaa nedarim hittiru chachamim, nidre zeruzin, venidre havay, venidre shegagot, venidre onasim. nidre zeruzin, ketzad. haya mocher chefetz veamar, konam sheeni fochet lecha min hassela, vehalla omer, konam sheeni mosif lecha al hashshekel, shenehen rotzin bishlosha dinarin. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, af harotze lehaddir et chavero sheyyochal etzlo, omer, kol neder sheani atid liddor hu vatel, uvilvad sheyyehe zachur bishat hanneder:
3.2: Nidre havay, amar, konam im lo raiti vadderech hazze cheyotze mitzrayim, im lo raiti nachash kekorat bet habbad. nidre shegagot, im achalti veim shatiti, venizkar sheachal veshata. sheani ochel vesheani shote, veshachach veachal veshata. amar, konam ishti nehenet li, shegganva et kisi veshehikketa et beni, venoda shello hikkattu venoda shello genavattu. raa otan ochlim teenim veamar, hare alechem karban, venimtzeu aviv veechav, vehayu immahen acherim, bet shammay omrim, hen muttarin uma sheimmahen asurin. uvet hillel omrim, ellu vaellu muttarin:
3.3: Nidre onasim, hiddiro chavero sheyyochal etzlo, vechala hu o shechala veno o sheikkevo nahar, hare ellu nidre onasin:
3.4: Nodrin lohoragin velochoramin velammochsin shehi teruma af al pi sheenah teruma, shehen shel bet hammelech af al pi sheenan shel bet hammelech. bet shammay omrim, bakkol nodrin, chutz mibbishvua. uvet hillel omrim, af bishvua. bet shammay omrim, lo yiftach lo veneder. uvet hillel omrim, af yiftach lo. bet shammay omrim, bema shehu maddiro. uvet hillel omrim, af bema sheeno maddiro. ketzad, amru lo, emor konam ishti nehenet li, veamar konam ishti uvanay nehenin li, bet shammay omrim, ishto mutteret uvanav asurin. uvet hillel omrim, ellu vaellu muttarin:
3.5: Hare netiot haellu karban im enan niktzatzot, tallit zo karban im enah nisrefet, yesh lahen pidyon. hare netiot haellu karban ad sheyyikkatztzu, tallit zo karban ad shettissaref, en lahem pidyon:
3.6: Hannoder miyyorde hayyam, muttar beyoshve hayyabbasha. miyyoshve hayyabbasha, asur beyorde hayyam, sheyyorde hayyam bichlal yoshve hayyabbasha. lo chaellu sheholchin meakko leyafo, ella vemi sheddarko lefaresh:
3.7: Hannoder meroe hachamma, asur af bassumin, shello nitkavven ze ella lemi shehachamma roa oto:
3.8: Hannoder mishshechore harosh, asur bakkerchin uvevaale sevot, umuttar bannashim uvakketannim, sheen nikrain shechore harosh ella anashim:
3.9: Hannoder min hayyillodim, muttar bannoladim. min hannoladim, asur bayyillodim. rabbi meir mattir af bayyillodim. vachachamim omrim, lo nitkavven ze ella vemi sheddarko leholid:
3.10: Hannoder mishshovte shabbat, asur beyisrael veasur bakkutim. meochle shum, asur beyisrael veasur bakkutim. meole yerushalayim, asur beyisrael umuttar bakkutim:
3.11: Konam sheeni nehene livne noach, muttar beyisrael veasur beummot haolam. sheeni nehene lezera avraham, asur beyisrael umuttar beummot haolam. sheeni nehene leyisrael, lokeach beyoter umocher befachot. sheyyisrael nehenin li, lokeach befachot umocher beyoter, im shomin lo. sheeni nehene lahen vehen li, yehanne lannachrim. konam sheeni nehene laarelim, muttar bearle yisrael veasur bemule haggoyim. konam sheeni nehene lammulim, asur bearle yisrael umuttar bemule haggoyim, sheen haarla keruya ella leshem haggoyim, shenneemar (yirmeya 9) ki chol haggoyim arelim vechol bet yisrael arle lev, veomer (Shmuel 1 17) vehaya happelishti hearel hazze, veomer (Shmuel b 1) pen tismachna benot pelishtim, pen taalozna benot haarelim. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, meusa arla shennitgannu vah harshaim, shenneemar, ki chol haggoyim arelim. rabbi yishmael omer, gedola mila shennichretu aleha shelosh esre veritot. rabbi yose omer, gedola mila, sheddocha et hashshabbat hachamura. rabbi yehoshua ben karcha omer, gedola mila, shello nitla lo lemoshe hatzaddik aleha melo shaa. rabbi nechemya omer, gedola mila, sheddocha et hannegaim. rabbi omer, gedola mila, shekkol hammitzvot sheasa avraham avinu lo nikra shalem, ad shemmal, shenneemar (Bereshit 17), hithallech lefanay vehye tamim. davar acher, gedola mila, sheilmale hi, lo vara hakkadosh baruch hu et olamo, shenneemar (yirmeya log), ko amar Adonai im lo veriti yomam valayla, chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti:

4.1: En ben hammuddar hanaa mechavero lammuddar hemennu maachol ella derisat haregel vechelim sheen osin bahen ochel nefesh. hammuddar maachol mechavero, lo yashilennu nafa uchevara verechayim vetannur, aval mashil lo chaluk vetabbaat vetallit unezamim, vechol davar sheen osin bo ochel nefesh. mekom shemmaskirin kayyotze vahen, asur:
4.2: Hammuddar hanaa mechavero, shokel et shiklo, uforea et chovo, umachazir lo et avedato. mekom shennotlin aleha sachar, tippol hanaa lahekdesh:
4.3: Vetorem et terumato umaasrotav ledato. umakriv alav kinne zavin, kinne zavot, kinne yoldot, chattaot vaashamot, umelammedo midrash, halachot veaggadot, aval lo yelammedennu mikra. aval melammed hu et banav veet benotav mikra, vezan et ishto veet banav af al pi shehu chayyav bimzonotehem. velo yazun et behemto, ben temea ben tehora. rabbi eliezer omer, zan et hattemea, veeno zan et hattehora. amru lo, ma ben temea lithora. amar lahen, shehattehora nafshah lashshamayim vegufah shello, utemea nafshah vegufah lashshamayim. amru lo, af hattemea nafshah lashshamayim vegufah shello, sheim yirtze, hare hu mochrah legoyim o maachilah lichlavim:
4.4: Hammuddar hanaa mechavero venichnas levakkero, omed, aval lo yoshev. umerappeehu refuat nefesh, aval lo refuat mamon. verochetz immo veambatiya gedola, aval lo viktanna. veyashen immo vemitta. rabbi yehuda omer, bimot hachamma, aval lo vimot haggeshamim, mippene shehu mehannehu. umesev immo al hammitta, veochel immo al hashshulchan, aval lo min hattamchuy, aval ochel hu immo min hattamchuy hachozer. lo yochal immo min haevus shellifne happoalim, velo yaase immo veumman, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, ose hu verichuk mimmennu:
4.5: Hammuddar hanaa mechavero lifne sheviit, lo yored letoch sadehu, veeno ochel min hannotot. uvashsheviit eno yored letoch sadehu, aval ochel hu min hannotot. nadar hemennu maachol lifne sheviit, yored letoch sadehu, veeno ochel min happerot. uvashsheviit, yored veochel:
4.6: Hammuddar hanaa mechavero, lo yashilennu velo yishal mimmennu, lo yalvennu velo yilve mimmennu, velo yimkor lo velo yikkach mimmennu. amar lo, hasheileni faratecha. amar lo, enah penuya. amar konam sadi sheani choresh bah leolam, im haya darko lacharosh, hu asur vechol adam muttarin. im en darko lacharosh, hu vechol adam asurin:
4.7: Hammuddar hanaa mechavero veen lo ma yochal, holech etzel hachenvani veomer, ish peloni muddar mimmenni hanaa veeni yodea ma eese, vehu noten lo uva venotel mizze. haya veto livnot, gedero ligdor, sadehu liktzor, holech etzel happoalim veomer, ish peloni muddar mimmenni hanaa veeni yodea ma eese. hem osin immo, uvain venotlin sachar mizze:
4.8: Hayu mehallechin badderech, veen lo ma yochal, noten leacher leshum mattana vehalla muttar bah. im en immahem acher, manniach al hassela o al haggader veomer, hare hen mufkarim lechol mi sheyyachpotz, vehalla notel veochel. verabbi yose oser:

5.1: Hashshuttafin shennadru hanaa ze mizze, asurin likkanes lechatzer. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, ze nichnas letoch shello veze nichnas letoch shello. ushenehem asurim lehaamid sham rechayim vetannur ulegaddel tarnegolim. haya echad mehem muddar hanaa mechavero, lo yikkanes lechatzer. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, yachol hu lomar lo, letoch shelli ani nichnas veeni nichnas letoch shellach. vechofin et hannoder limkor et chelko:
5.2: Haya echad min hashshuk muddar meechad mehem hanaa, lo yikkanes lechatzer. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, yachol hu lomar lo, letoch shel chavercha ani nichnas, veeni nichnas letoch shellach:
5.3: Hammuddar hanaa mechavero, veyesh lo merchatz uvet habbad muskarim bair, im yesh lo vahen tefisat yad, asur. en lo vahen tefisat yad, muttar. haomer lachavero, konam levetcha sheani nichnas vesadcha sheani lokeach, met o shemmecharo leacher, muttar. konam levayit ze sheani nichnas, sade zo sheani lokeach, met o shemmecharo leacher, asur:
5.4: Hareni alecha cherem, hammuddar asur. hare at alay cherem, hannoder asur. hareni alecha veat alay, shenehem asurin. ushenehem muttarin bedavar shel ole vavel, vaasurin bedavar shel otah hair:
5.5: Veezehu davar shel ole vavel, kegon har habbayit vehaazarot vehabbor shebbeemtza hadderech. veezehu davar shel otah hair, kegon harchava vehammerchatz, uvet hakkeneset vehatteva vehassefarim. vehakkotev chelko lannasi. rabbi yehuda omer, echad kotev lannasi veechad kotev lehedyot. ma ben kotev lannasi lechotev lehedyot, shehakkotev lannasi eno tzarich lezakkot. vachachamim omrim, echad ze veechad ze tzerichin lezakkot. lo dibberu vannasi ella vahove. rabbi yehuda omer, en anshe galil tzerichin lichtov, shekkevar katvu avotehem al yedehem:
5.6: Hammuddar hanaa mechavero veen lo ma yochal, notno leacher leshum mattana, vehalla muttar bah. maase veechad bevet choron shehaya aviv muddar hemennu hanaa, vehaya massi et beno, veamar lachavero, chatzer useuda netunim lecha vemattana, veenan lefanecha ella chede sheyyavo abba veyochal immanu basseuda. amar lo, im shelli hem, hare hem mukdashin lashshamayim. amar lo, lo natatti et shelli shettakdishem lashshamayim. amar lo, lo natatta li et shellecha ella shettehe atta veavicha ochlim veshotim umitratztzim ze laze, vihe avon taluy berosho. ucheshebba davar lifne chachamim, amru, kol mattana sheenah sheim hikdishah enah mekuddeshet, enah mattana:

6.1: Hannoder min hamevushshal, muttar batztzali uvashshaluk. amar konam tavshil sheeni toem, asur bemaase kedera rach, umuttar beave umuttar bevetzat teramita, uvidlaat harmutza:
6.2: Hannoder mimmaase kedera, eno asur ella mimmaase retachta. amar, konam hayyored lakkedera sheeni toem, asur bechol hammitbashshelin bakkedera:
6.3: Min hakkavush, eno asur ella min hakkavush shel yarak. kavush sheeni toem, asur bechol hakkevushim. min hashshaluk, eno asur ella min hashshaluk shel basar. shaluk sheeni toem, asur bechol hashshelakim. min hatztzali, eno asur ella min hatztzali shel basar, divre rabbi yehuda. tzali sheeni toem, asur bechol hatztzeluyim. min hammaliach, eno asur ella min hammaliach shel dag. maliach sheeni toem, asur bechol hammeluchim:
6.4: Dag dagim sheeni toem, asur bahen, ben gedolim ben ketannim, ben meluchin ben tefelin, ben chayyin ben mevushshalin, umuttar betarit terufa uvetzir. hannoder min hatztzachana, asur betarit terufa, umuttar betzir uvemuryas. hannoder mittarit terufa, asur betzir uvemuryas:
6.5: Hannoder min hechalav, muttar bakkum. verabbi yose oser. min hakkum, muttar bechalav. abba shaul omer, hannoder min haggevina, asur bah ben melucha ben tefela:
6.6: Hannoder min habbasar, muttar barotev uvakkippa. verabbi yehuda oser. amar rabbi yehuda, maase veasar alay rabbi tarfon betzim shennitbashshelu immo. amru lo, vechen haddavar, ematay, bizman sheyyomar basar ze alay, shehannoder min haddavar venitarev beacher, im yesh bo venoten taam, asur:
6.7: Hannoder min hayyayin, muttar betavshil sheyyesh bo taam yayin. amar konam yayin ze sheeni toem, venafal letavshil, im yesh bo venoten taam, hare ze asur. hannoder min haanavim, muttar beyayin. min hazzetim, muttar beshemen. amar konam zetim vaanavim ellu sheeni toem, asur bahen uvayyotze mehen:
6.8: Hannoder min hattemarim, muttar bidvash temarim. missitvaniyyot, muttar bechometz sitvaniyyot. rabbi yehuda ven betera omer, kol sheshshem toladto keruya alav venoder hemennu, asur af bayyotze hemennu. vachachamim mattirin:
6.9: Hannoder min hayyayin, muttar beyen tappuchim. min hashshemen, muttar beshemen shumshemin. min haddevash, muttar bidvash temarim. min hachometz, muttar bechometz sitvaniyyot. min hakkereshin, muttar bekaflotot. min hayyarak, muttar beyarkot hassade, mippene shehu shem levay:
6.10: Min hakkeruv, asur beispargos. min haispargos, muttar bichruv. min haggerisim, asur min hammikpa, verabbi yose mattir. min hammikpa, muttar bigrisin. min hammikpa, asur beshum, verabbi yose mattir. min hashshum, muttar bemikpa. min haadashim, asur baashishin, verabbi yose mattir. min haashishim, muttar baadashim. chitta chittim sheeni toem, asur bahen ben kemach ben pat. geris gerisin sheeni toem, asur bahen ben chayyin ben mevushshalim. rabbi yehuda omer, konam geris o chitta sheeni toem, muttar lachos chayyim:

7.1: Hannoder min hayyarak, muttar bidluin. verabbi akiva oser. amru lo lerabbi akiva, vahalo omer adam lishlucho kach li yarak vehu omer lo matzati ella deluin. amar lahem, ken haddavar, o shemma omer hu lo lo matzati ella kitnit, ella shehaddeluin bichlal yarak, vekitnit enan bichlal yarak. veasur befol hammitzri lach, umuttar bayyavesh:
7.2: Hannoder min haddagan, asur befol hammitzri yavesh, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, eno asur ella vachameshet hamminin. rabbi meir omer, hannoder min hattevua, eno asur ella mechameshet hamminin. aval hannoder min haddagan, asur bakkol, umuttar beferot hailan uveyarak:
7.3: Hannoder min hakkesut, muttar besak, biria, uvachamila. amar konam tzemer ole alay, muttar lehitkassot begizze tzemer. pishtan ole alay, muttar lehitkassot baanitze fishtan. rabbi yehuda omer, hakkol lefi hannoder. taan vehizzia vehaya recho kashe, amar konam tzemer ufishtim ole alay, muttar lehitkassot veasur lehafeshil laachorav:
7.4: Hannoder min habbayit, muttar baaliyya, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, aliyya bichlal habbayit. hannoder min haaliyya, muttar babbayit:
7.5: Hannoder min hammitta, muttar bedargash, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, dargash bichlal mitta. hannoder min haddargash, muttar bemitta. hannoder min hair, muttar likkanes litchumah shel ir, veasur likkanes leibburah. aval hannoder min habbayit, asur min haagaf velifnim:
7.6: Konam perot haellu alay, konam hen al pi, konam hen lefi, asur bechillufehen uvegiddulehen. sheani ochel vesheani toem, muttar bechillufehen uvegiddulehen, bedavar shezzaro chale. aval bedavar sheen zaro chale, afillu giddule giddulin asurin:
7.7: Haomer leishto, konam maase yadayich alay, konam hen al pi, konam hen lefi, asur bechillufehen uvegiddulehen. sheeni ochel, sheeni toem, muttar bechillufehen uvegiddulehen, bedavar shezzaro chale. aval bedavar sheen zaro chale, afillu giddule giddulin asurim:
7.8: Sheat osa eni ochel ad happesach, sheat osa eni mitkasse ad happesach, asta lifne happesach, muttar leechol ulehitkassot achar happesach. sheat osa ad happesach eni ochel, vesheat osa ad happesach eni mitkasse, asta lifne happesach, asur leechol ulehitkassot achar happasach:
7.9: Sheat nehenet li ad happesach im telchi levet avich ad hechag, halcha lifne happesach, asura vahanaato ad happesach. achar happesach, belo yachel devaro. sheat nehenet li ad hechag im telchi levet avich ad happesach, vehalcha lifne happesach, asura vahanaato ad hechag, umutteret lelech achar happasach:

8.1: Konam yayin sheani toem hayyom, eno asur ella ad shettechshach. shabbat zo, asur bechol hashshabbat, veshabbat sheavra. chodesh ze, asur bechol hachodesh, verosh chodesh lehabba. shana zo, asur bechol hashshana, verosh hashshana leatid lavo. shavua ze, asur bechol hashshavua, usheviit sheavra. veim amar yom echad, shabbat echat, chodesh echad, shana echat, shavua echad, asur miyyom leyom:
8.2: Ad happesach, asur ad sheyyaggia. ad sheyyehe, asur ad sheyyetze. ad lifne happesach, rabbi meir omer, asur ad sheyyaggia. rabbi yose omer, asur ad sheyyetze:
8.3: Ad hakkatzir, ad habbatzir, ad hammasik, eno asur ella ad sheyyaggia. ze hakkelal, kol shezzemanno kavua veamar ad sheyyaggia, asur ad sheyyaggiyya. amar ad sheyyehe, asur ad sheyyetze. vechol sheen zemanno kavua, ben amar ad sheyyehe, ben amar ad sheyyaggia, eno asur ella ad sheyyaggia:
8.4: Ad hakkayitz, ad sheyyehe hakkayitz, ad sheyatchilu haam lehachenis bakkalkallot. ad sheyyaavor hakkayitz, ad sheyyekappelu hammaktzuot. ad hakkatzir, ad sheyyatchil haam liktzor, ketzir chittin aval lo ketzir seorim. hakkol lefi mekom nidro, im haya vahar, bahar, veim haya vabbika, babbika:
8.5: Ad haggeshamim, ad sheyyihyu haggeshamim, ad shettered revia sheniyya. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, ad sheyyaggia zemannah shel revia. ad sheyyippasku geshamim, ad sheyyetze nisan kullo, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyaavor happesach. konam yayin sheeni toem hashshana, nitabbera hashshana, asur bah uveibburah. ad rosh adar, ad rosh adar harishon. ad sof adar, ad sof adar harishon. rabbi yehuda omer, konam yayin sheeni toem ad sheyyehe happesach, eno asur ella ad lel happesach, shello nitkavven ze ella ad shaa shedderech bene adam lishtot yayin:
8.6: Amar konam basar sheeni toem ad sheyyehe hatztzom, eno asur ella ad lele tzom, shello nitkavven ze ella ad shaa shedderech bene adam leechol basar. rabbi yose veno omer, konam shum sheeni toem ad shettehe shabbat, eno asur ella ad lele shabbat, shello nitkavven ze ella ad shaa shedderech bene adam leechol shum:
8.7: Haomer lachavero konam sheani nehene lecha im en atta va venotel levanecha kor echad shel chittin ushete chaviyyot shel yayin, hare ze yachol lehafer et nidro shello al pi chacham, veyomar lo, kelum amarta ella mippene chevodi, zehu chevodi. vechen haomer lachavero konam sheatta nehene li im en atta va venoten livni kor echad shel chittin ushete chaviyyot shel yayin, rabbi meir omer, asur ad sheyyitten. vachachamim omrim, af ze yachol lehafer et nidro shello al pi chacham, veyomar lo, hare ani cheillu hitkabbalti. hayu mesarvin bo laset bat achoto veamar konam shehi nehenet li leolam, vechen hamegaresh et ishto veamar konam ishti nehenet li leolam, hare ellu muttarot lehanot lo, shello nitkavven ze ella leshum ishut. haya mesarev bachavero sheyyochal etzlo, amar konam levetcha sheeni nichnas, tippat tzonen sheeni toem lach, muttar likkanes leveto velishtot mimmennu tzonen, shello nitkavven ze ella leshum achila ushetiyya:

9.1: Rabbi eliezer omer, potchin laadam bichvod aviv veimmo. vachachamim osrin. amar rabbi tzadok, ad sheppotchin lo vichvod aviv veimmo, yiftechu lo vichvod hammakom, im ken en nedarim. umodim chachamim lerabbi eliezer bedavar shebbeno leven aviv veimmo, sheppotchin lo bichvod aviv veimmo:
9.2: Veod amar rabbi eliezer, potchin benolad. vachachamim osrin. ketzad. amar, konam sheeni nehene leish peloni, venaasa sofer, o shehaya massi et beno vekarov, veamar, illu hayiti yodea shehu naase sofer o shehu massi et beno vekarov, lo hayiti noder. konam levayit ze sheeni nichnas, venaasa vet hakkeneset, veamar, illu hayiti yodea shehu naase vet hakkeneset lo hayiti noder, rabbi eliezer mattir, vachachamim osrin:
9.3: Rabbi meir omer, yesh devarim shehen kenolad veenan kenolad, veen chachamim modim lo. ketzad. amar, konam sheeni nose et pelonit, sheaviha ra. amru lo, met o sheasa teshuva. konam levayit ze sheeni nichnas, shehakkelev ra betocho o shehannachash betocho. amru lo, met hakkelev o shenneherag hannachash, hare hen kenolad veenan kenolad, veen chachamim modim lo:
9.4: Veod amar rabbi meir potchin lo min hakkatuv shebbattora veomrim lo, illu hayita yodea sheatta over al lo tikkom veal lo tittor (Vayikra 19), veal lo tisna et achicha bilvavecha (sham), veahavta lereacha kamocha (sham), veche achicha immach (sham 25), shemma yeani veen atta yachol lefarneso. amar, illu hayiti yodea shehu chen, lo hayiti noder, hare ze muttar:
9.5: Potchin laadam bichtubbat ishto. umaase veechad shennadar meishto hanaa vehayta chetubbatah arba meot dinarin, uva lifne rabbi akiva vechiyyevo litten lah ketubbatah. amar lo, rabbi, shemone meot dinarin hinniach abba, venatal achi arba meot vaani arba meot, lo dayyah shettittol hi matayim, vaani matayim. amar lo rabbi akiva, afillu atta mocher sear roshcha, atta noten lah ketubbatah. amar lo, illu hayiti yodea shehu chen, lo hayiti noder, vehittirah rabbi akiva:
9.6: Potchin beyamim tovim uveshabbatot. barishona hayu omrim, otan hayyamim muttarin ushear kol hayyamim asurin, ad shebba rabbi akiva velimmed, shehanneder shehuttar miktzato, huttar kullo:
9.7: Ketzad. amar, konam sheeni nehene lechullechem, huttar echad mehen, hutteru chullan. sheeni nehene laze velaze, huttar harishon, hutteru chullan. huttar haacharon, haacharon muttar, vechullan asurin. huttar haemtzai, hemennu ulematta muttar, hemennu ulemala asur. sheeni nehene laze karban velaze karban, tzerichin petach lechol echad veechad:
9.8: Konam yayin sheeni toem, shehayyayin ra lammeayim, amru lo, vahalo hameyushshan yafe lammeayim, huttar bamyushshan. velo vamyushshan bilvad huttar, ella vechol hayyayin. konam batzal sheeni toem, shehabbatzal ra lallev. amru lo, halo hakkufri yafe lallev, huttar bakkufri. velo vakkufri vilvad huttar, ella vechol habbetzalim. maase haya, vehittiro rabbi meir bechol habbetzalim:
9.9: Potchin laadam bichvod atzmo uvichvod banav. omrim lo, illu hayita yodea shellemachar omrin alecha kach hi visto shel peloni, megaresh et nashav, veal benotecha yihyu omrin benot gerushot hen, ma raata imman shel ellu lehitgaresh, veamar, illu hayiti yodea shekken, lo hayiti noder, hare ze muttar:
9.10: Konam sheeni nose et pelonit keura, vahare hi naa. shechora, vahare hi levana. ketzara, vahare hi arukka, muttar bah. lo mippene shehi cheura venaaset naa, shechora venaaset levana, ketzara venaaset arukka, ella shehanneder taut. umaase veechad shennadar mibbat achoto hanaya, vehichnisuha levet rabbi yishmael veyippuha. amar lo rabbi yishmael, beni, lazo nadarta. amar lo, lav. vehittiro rabbi yishmael. beotah shaa bacha rabbi yishmael veamar, benot yisrael naot hen, ella shehaaniyyut menavvaltan. ucheshemmet rabbi yishmael, hayu venot yisrael nosot kina veomrot, benot yisrael el rabbi yishmael bechena. vechen hu omer beshaul (Shmuel b 1) benot yisrael el shaul bechena:

10.1: Naara hameorasa, aviha uvalah meferin nedareha. hefer haav velo hefer habbaal, hefer habbaal velo hefer haav, eno mufar, veen tzarich lomar shekkiyyem echad mehen:
10.2: Met haav, lo nitrokna reshut labbaal. met habbaal, nitrokna reshut laav. baze yafe choach haav mikkoach habbaal. bedavar acher yafe choach habbaal mikkoach haav, shehabbaal mefer beveger, vehaav eno mefer bevager:
10.3: Nadra vehi arusa, nitgarsha vo vayyom, nitarsa vo vayyom, afillu lemea, aviha uvalah haacharon meferin nedareha. ze hakkelal, kol shello yatzat lirshut atzmah shaa echat, aviha uvalah haacharon meferin nedareha:
10.4: Derech talmide chachamim, ad shello hayta vitto yotza meetzlo, omer lah, kol nedarim shennadart betoch beti, hare hen mufarin. vechen habbaal ad shello tikkanes lirshuto, omer lah, kol nedarim shennadart ad shello tikkansi lirshuti, hare hen mufarin, shemmishshettikkanes lirshuto eno yachol lehafer:
10.5: Bogeret sheshshahata shenem asar chodesh, vealmana sheloshim yom, rabbi eliezer omer, hoil uvalah chayyav bimzonoteha, yafer. vachachamim omrim, en habbaal mefer, ad shettikkanes lirshuto:
10.6: Shomeret yavam, ben leyavam echad ben lishne yevamin, rabbi eliezer omer, yafer. rabbi yehoshua omer, leechad aval lo lishnayim. rabbi akiva omer, lo leechad velo lishnayim. amar rabbi eliezer, ma im ishsha, shekkana hu leatzmo, hare hu mefer nedareha, ishsha shehiknu lo min hashshamayim, eno din sheyyafer nedareha. amar lo rabbi akiva, lo, im amarta veishsha shekkana hu leatzmo, sheen laacherim bah reshut, tomar beishsha shehiknu lo min hashshamayim, sheyyesh laacherim bah reshut. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, akiva, devarecha vishne yevamin. ma atta meshiv al yavam echad. amar lo, en hayevama gemura layyavam keshem shehaarusa gemura leishah:
10.7: Haomer leishto, kol hannedarim shettidderi mikkan ad sheavo mimmakom peloni, hare hen kayyamin, lo amar kelum. hare hen mufarin, rabbi eliezer omer, mufar. vachachamim omrim, eno mufar. amar rabbi eliezer, im hefer nedarim shebbau lichlal issur, lo yafer nedarim shello vau lichlal issur. amru lo, hare hu omer, ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu (Bamidbar 30), et shebba lichlal hakem, ba lichlal hafer. lo va lichlal hakem, lo va lichlal hafer:
10.8: Hafarat nedarim, kol hayyom. yesh baddavar lehakel ulehachamir. ketzad. nadra belele shabbat, yafer belele shabbat uveyom hashshabbat ad shettechshach. nadra im chashecha, mefer ad shello techshach. sheim chashcha velo hefer, eno yachol lehafer:

11.1: Veellu nedarim shehu mefer, devarim sheyyesh bahem innuy nefesh, im erchatz veim lo erchatz, im etkashshet veim lo etkashshet. amar rabbi yose, en ellu nidre innuy nafesh:
11.2: Veellu hem nidre innuy nefesh. amra, konam perot haolam alay, hare ze yachol lehafer. perot medina alay, yavi lah mimmedina acheret. perot chenvani ze alay, eno yachol lehafer. veim lo hayta farnasato ella mimmennu, hare ze yafer, divre rabbi yose:
11.3: Konam sheeni nehena labberiyyot, eno yachol lehafer, vichola hi lehanot beleket uveshichcha uvefea. konam kohanim uleviyyim nehenim li, yittelu al karcho. kohanim ellu uleviyyim ellu nehenim li, yittelu acherim:
11.4: Konam sheeni osa al pi abba, veal pi avicha, veal pi achi, veal pi achicha, eno yachol lehafer. sheeni osa al picha, eno tzarich lehafer. rabbi akiva omer, yafer, shemma tadif alav yoter min harauy lo. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, yafer, shemma yegarshenna utehi asura alav:
11.5: Nadra ishto vesavur shennadra vitto, nadra vitto vesavur shennadra ishto, nadra venazir vesavur shennadra vekarban, nadra vekarban vesavur shennadra venazir, nadra min hatteenim vesavur shennadra min haanavim, nadra min haanavim vesavur shennadra min hatteenim, hare ze yachazor veyafer:
11.6: Amra, konam teenim vaanavim ellu sheeni toemet, kiyyem latteenim, kullo kayyam. hefer latteenim, eno mufar ad sheyyafer af laanavim. amra, konam teenim sheeni toemet vaanavim sheeni toemet, hare ellu shene nedarim:
11.7: Yodea ani sheyyesh nedarim, aval eni yodea sheyyesh meferin, yafer. yodea ani sheyyesh meferin aval eni yodea shezze neder, rabbi meir omer, lo yafer, vachachamim omrim, yafer:
11.8: Hammuddar hanaa mechatano vehu rotze latet levitto maot, omer lah, hare hammaot haellu netunim lach bemattana uvilvad shello yehe levalech reshut bahen, ella ma sheat noset venotenet befich:
11.9: Veneder almana ugerusha yakum aleha (Bamidbar 30). ketzad. amra, hareni nezira leachar sheloshim yom, af al pi shennisset betoch sheloshim yom, eno yachol lehafer. nadra vehi virshut habbaal, mefer lah. ketzad. amra, hareni nezira leachar sheloshim, af al pi shennitalmena o nitgarsha vetoch sheloshim, hare ze mufar. nadra vo vayyom, nitgarsha vo vayyom, hechezirah bo vayyom, eno yachol lehafer. ze hakkelal, kol sheyyatzat lirshut atzmah shaa achat, eno yachol lehafer:
11.10: Tesha nearot, nidrehen kayyamin. bogeret vehi yetoma, naara uvagra vehi yetoma, naara shello vagra vehi yetoma, bogeret umet aviha, naara vogeret umet aviha, naara shello vagra umet aviha, naara shemmet aviha umishshemmet aviha bagra, bogeret veaviha kayyam, naara vogeret veaviha kayyam. rabbi yehuda omer, af hammassi vitto hakketanna, venitalmena o nitgarsha vechazra etzlo, adayin hi naara:
11.11: Konam sheeni nehenet leabba uleavicha im osa ani al picha, sheeni nehenet lecha im osa ani al pi abba, veal pi avicha, hare ze yafer:
11.12: Barishona hayu omrim, shalosh nashim yotzot venotlot ketubba, haomeret temea ani lecha, shamayim beni levenecha, netula ani min hayyehudim. chazru lomar, shello tehe ishsha notenet eneha veacher umekalkelet al balah. ella haomeret temea ani lecha, tavi reaya lidvareha. shamayim beni levenecha, yaasu derech bakkasha. netula ani min hayyehudim, yafer chelko, utehe meshammashto, utehe netula min hayyehudim:
